baseline: Zooming Secretary M27 message fitting and player readability

transient feedback uses bounded bitmap text rather than system-font fillText

player is rendered from multiple body parts instead of the old 10×17 rectangle
walk animation changes limbs without changing the 16×24 logical player footprint
left/right facing changes face and hair details
gameplay collision/motion core is byte-identical to M26
M26 procedural audio engine is unchanged
new player remains clean-room procedural rendering with no image asset dependency
release still bundles no sampled audio or raster player assets
